title: Current-v21 Railway source proof and negative population sweep

findings.result: The strict Railway-only full-world proof on server 2207 completed 2500/2500 logical blocks with no scan failure/unread condition, then failed only at the intentional positive-population guard because zero Railway/Train rows were published.

The official current-client Train-list population harness queried 11 servers through the game-owned Railway source. Every server query completed in proven state; all returned zero Railway rows. This fresh v21 evidence proves the direct source path itself is functioning while positive Railway population/Follow remains unavailable.
The live proof output label was renamed from current_v20_official_train_list_population to current_client_official_train_list_population so future evidence does not mislabel newer clients.

strictFullScan.result: Ordinary Manual Railway scan published no Railway/Train records.

acceptanceImpact: none; fresh v21 Railway source acquisition is live-proven, but positive-row/Follow acceptance remains population-gated
limits: No positive Railway row was available, so real v21 Follow and positive-row sort/reopen acceptance are not promoted.
The 11-server sweep is a sampled population observation, not a claim that Railway can never appear there.
Process runtimes include lifecycle startup/cleanup and cross-server travel and are not scan SLAs.
